decisions.reason: Prioritizing conversion over appearance does not alter the existing requirement for a viral creative style.
The conversion-priority decision does not change the required directness or Indian-market alignment of the opening hook.
The source establishes an overall optimization priority but does not change the specified reference-based creative foundation or its relationship to the reference.
Accurate lip sync and natural facial expressions remain required and are not revised by the campaign-level conversion priority.
The source does not alter the required reference basis, keyword usage, message fidelity, or revision style.
The requirement for retention-focused cuts remains valid unchanged; the source adds no specific editing modification.
The conversion-priority decision does not change the defined audience age range or Indian-market context.
The source does not revise the source or presentation of testimonial material.
The clear, naturally integrated call to action remains required and is not changed by the overall conversion objective.
The source does not decide the disputed production method or change the requirements concerning live-action footage, avatars, or static-image animation.
